text: The Civic Appointments Committee must select candidates to be interviewed for the PortsToronto Board of Directors. The Interview Subcommittee for Toronto Port Authority will conduct the interviews and will make recommendations to the Civic Appointments Committee.

The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Directed that the Interview Subcommittee for Toronto Port Authority interview the following candidates for appointment to the PortsToronto Board of Directors: Candidate #58 Candidate #84 Candidate #92 Candidate #17 Candidate #21 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachments 1, 2 and 3 to the report (December 21, 2017) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the PortsToronto Board of Directors.
